Ninja Adventure Asset Pack
Pixel-Boy & AAA
https://pixel-boy.itch.io/ninja-adventure-asset-pack
https://github.com/pixel-boy/NinjaAdventure

CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain).

Divecore uses the interior floor tile, a bush and potted plant from the
village tileset, and one heart icon. Those pixels were quantized toward
the room's brick and plank colours and packed into assets/play/pixel/room-atlas.png.

Resurrect 64 (Kerrie Lake, CC0, https://lospec.com/palette-list/resurrect-64)
is the palette the Dive atlas was recolored toward. It is not a sprite pack.

Original Divecore pixels in the same atlases (room window, lamp, shelf, rug,
bed, bowl, picture, cloud, mote; Dive sky, chests, light rays, caustics and
the second bubble) were drawn for this app.
